design.F-1: recordFirstCommandOnMarker catches any marker read or write error, logs it through logger.warn with the campaign and command ids, and returns; acknowledgeCommit then replays and acknowledges the committed batch as before. The marker write is not moved into the journal transaction.
design.F-3: No product change: a pin row drives an AcceptContract through executeCampaignCommand on a journal-native campaign (genesis + journal-native marker + a durable offer in the campaigns row, real SQLite) and asserts the durable marker stamps firstJournalAuthorityCommandId with that command id; mutant M3 proves the row catches a skipped stamp.
design.gate3Scope: resolveCampaignEventScope throws a typed CampaignFundsScopeError (name, code, type, scope) when type is FundsChanged and an override other than campaign is passed; the default and an explicit campaign override still resolve to campaign; other types keep their override. campaignEventScope.test.ts:108 is re-pinned to the refusal.
design.adoption: adoptLegacyCampaign appends the genesis snapshot through appendCampaignGenesis (the create path seam) and so writes the journal-native marker; its retry guard treats a marker already in journal state, or one carrying an imported baseline, as already-journaled so a retry never rewrites the marker (and never clears a stamped firstJournalAuthorityCommandId). maybeAdoptLegacyCampaign keeps its enabled gate; the flag is unchanged, so the adopt route still passes false in production. campaignLegacyAdoption.test.ts is re-pinned from shadowing to journal-native.

risksForTheParent: Review classes authority + idempotency: Lane B needs the owner head-bound OWNER-RULING on the exact head this unit merges; OD-mvp-hard-cutover delegates the design answers, not the ruling.

Idempotency (F-1): after a swallowed marker failure the marker keeps firstJournalAuthorityCommandId null, so the NEXT committed command id is stamped as the first; the D10 rollback guard that reads it then names a later command. Under OD-mvp-hard-cutover the rollback law is not required, and the commit itself is never duplicated (the journal command identity is unchanged).

Authority (adoption): an adopted campaign is journal-native (importedBaseline null), so the imported revision and digest are no longer recorded and D10 snapshot rollback is gone for adopted campaigns; its baseline is now system-authored genesis (commandId campaign-genesis:<id>), which the U58 baseline-law predicate treats as a genesis baseline that reaches restricted viewers.

Clause (4) takes effect only when the adopt route passes enabled true: production passes isCampaignJournalAuthorityEnabled() (false until U35d; true only under the e2e fixture arm). An adopted campaign under journal authority then accepts whole-envelope PUTs that leave the journal behind (gate 3, owned by U35b).

The FundsChanged refusal is a throw at event construction; no production site passes a FundsChanged override today (CampaignMatchHostIntent.ts:156,179), so no production path changes, but a future emission with a gm override fails at construction instead of stamping gm.
